events.context_en: The dustiest day in the 605-day harmattan sample: 2,354 µg/m³ daily mean dust, with 2,302 µg/m³ the next day.
events.context_ha: Ranar da ƙura ta fi yawa a cikin kwanaki 605 da aka auna: 2,354 µg/m³ a matsakaici, sai 2,302 µg/m³ washegari.

level_meta.blurb_en: Very heavy dust. Protect people and goods.
level_meta.blurb_ha: Ƙura mai haɗari. Ka kare mutane da kaya.

headline.en: Dangerous dust. Stay indoors where you can.
headline.ha: Ƙura mai haɗari. Ka kasance a ciki idan za ka iya.

laundry.en: Keep laundry indoors. If you must dry outside, cover it with a sheet.
laundry.ha: Ajiye tufafi a ciki. Idan dole sai an shimfiɗa a waje, a rufe su da mayafi.

market.en: Pack goods away or cover them fully. Sell from a closed stall if you can.
market.ha: Kaɗa kayanka ko ka rufe su sosai. Idan za ka iya, sayar daga rumfa da aka rufe.

school.en: Keep children indoors if possible. If school is open, close windows and skip outdoor play.
school.ha: Idan zai yiwu, a tsayar da yara a ciki. Idan makaranta a buɗe, a rufe tagogi kuma a daina wasa a waje.

health.en: People with breathing problems should stay indoors. Seek care if breathing gets hard.
health.ha: Masu matsalar numfashi su kasance a ciki. Nemi taimakon likita idan numfashi ya yi wahala.

headline.en: No flood signal in the next three days.
headline.ha: Babu alamar ambaliya a cikin kwanaki uku masu zuwa.

advice.en: Normal conditions. Keep drains clear while it is dry.
advice.ha: Yanayi na al'ada. A share magudanar ruwa yayin da ƙasa ta bushe.

events.context_en: A real rainy-season day with 38.7 mm in 24 h. The flood rule puts this above the 30 mm high floor; the next day is included in the 72-hour total.
events.context_ha: Ranar ruwan sama ta gaske: 38.7 mm cikin awa 24. Dokar ambaliya ta haɗa wannan da ruwan kwanaki uku.

level_meta.blurb_en: Clean air. A normal harmattan day.
level_meta.blurb_ha: Iska mai kyau. Rana ta al'ada ce.

headline.en: Dust is low today in Gombe.
headline.ha: Yau ƙura ba ta da yawa a Gombe.

laundry.en: Good drying weather. Hang clothes outside as normal.
laundry.ha: Yanayi mai kyau don busar da tufafi. Ka shimfiɗa a waje.

market.en: A normal day to display goods in the open.
market.ha: Rana ta al'ada ce don baje kaya a waje.

school.en: Children can walk to school as usual.
school.ha: Yara za su iya zuwa makaranta kamar kullum.

health.en: Air is clear. People with asthma can go about normally.
health.ha: Iska a buɗe take. Masu asma za su iya tafiya kamar kullum.
